title: AI histopathology analysis identifies a poor-prognosis subset of NSMP endometrial cancer
summary: AI-powered histopathology image analysis separated p53abn from NSMP endometrial cancers and identified a NSMP subgroup termed p53abn-like NSMP with markedly inferior progression-free and disease-specific survival. The finding came from a discovery cohort of 368 patients and was reported in two independent validation cohorts of 290 and 614 patients; shallow whole genome sequencing showed higher copy-number burden in the subgroup.
ai_technology: AI-based histopathology image analysis distinguishing p53abn from NSMP endometrial cancer

evidence.tested: Discovery cohort (368) and independent validation cohorts (290 and 614) from other centres; shallow whole genome sequencing.
evidence.unknown: Retrospective cohorts; not tested as a treatment-guiding tool; abstract only; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: The image model separated p53abn from NSMP cases and revealed the p53abn-like NSMP subgroup.
